carrier_event = {
    id = colony_automation_event.2
    hide_window = yes
    is_triggered_only = yes
    trigger = {
        free_district_slots = 0
        NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_disable_planet_auto_destruction_district }
        check_variable = {
            which = bca_num_queued_districts
            value = 0
        }
    }
    immediate = {
        # 振荡守卫：方案低于现状须连续 2 个月才执行拆除，防止专精规划与玩家区划方案互相拆建（2026-10-19 玩家反馈 #3 修复）
        set_variable = {
            which = bca_district_demolition_signal
            value = 0
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable_arithmetic = {
                    which = value:bca_num_primary_districts_plan
                    value < value:num_primary_district
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                which = bca_district_demolition_signal
                value = 1
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                # 2026-11-16：高级星球（机械/纳米/蜂巢/环世界/城市世界）的区划按「层级」归类，
                # 与槽的产出族无关；那里的拆除交给玩家，避免把发电枢纽当成多余矿物拆掉。
                NOT = { bca_has_advance_secondary_districts = yes }
                # 2026-11-21：锁定的槽不参与自动拆除判定。

                check_variable = {
                    which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3

                }
            }

                which = bca_district_demolition_signal
                value = 1
            }
        }

            limit = {
